title: Woman killed in Sunday I-35 crash identified as 38-year-old Susana Gabriela Calderón
excerpt: Laredo police have identified the woman killed in a Sunday morning crash on northbound I-35 as 38-year-old Susana Gabriela Calderón. The 35-year-old driver remains in critical condition.
content:
Laredo police have identified the woman killed in a crash early Sunday morning on Interstate 35 as 38-year-old Susana Gabriela Calderón, according to KGNS.

The crash happened at about 4:30 a.m. Sunday, November 8, on northbound I-35 near Exit 2, KGNS reported. The truck struck a light pole and came to rest near San Dario and Blair.

Calderón was a passenger in the truck. The 35-year-old male driver remains in critical condition, according to KGNS.

According to Laredo Police spokesperson Joe Baeza, the driver lost control of the truck before it hit the pole. Both occupants were unconscious when first responders arrived and had not regained consciousness, Baeza said. Both were taken to a hospital, where Calderón died.

The Laredo Police Department's crash team is investigating the crash, and weather is being considered as a possible factor, according to KGNS.

Sources: KGNS, November 9, 2026; Laredo Morning Times, November 9, 2026.
